content: The current evidence is limited regarding the optimal frequency of blood glucose monitoring (BGM) for individuals who are managing their diabetes using only basal insulin or non-insulin injectable medications. While BGM, when used independently, has been associated with modest reductions in A1C levels, its effectiveness is significantly enhanced when integrated into a structured self-management program. Specifically, structured BGM has been shown to improve outcomes by approximately 3% more compared to unstructured BGM practices.
